# When Not to Use

## Purpose

- Reject nearby tasks that mention backend work but do not actually require an MCP server change.

## Do not use this skill for

- General backend services, APIs, or workers that do not expose MCP capabilities.
- Prompt, skill, or custom agent authoring.
- High-level architecture exploration with no concrete MCP server implementation or configuration work.
- Generic tool discovery questions that do not modify an MCP server or its VS Code registration.
